content:
Quynh and her friend Sarah are on holiday in Da Lat. It's their second morning, and they are having breakfast in a small coffee shop.

Sarah asks, "What shall we do today?"
Quynh looks out of the window. "It's sunny. I know! We'll rent bicycles and ride around the lake."
"Good idea. Where can we rent them?"
"There's a shop next to the café. I'll ask the waiter."
The waiter says, "The shop opens at eight. A bicycle is 50,000 dong for a day."
Sarah says, "That's cheap. We'll take two."
"After the lake, shall we visit a flower farm? There's one on the hill."
Sarah asks, "Is it far?"
"About five kilometres. The road goes up the hill, so it won't be easy."
Sarah laughs. "Then I'll probably walk with my bicycle!"
"That's OK. We'll have lunch at the farm."
Quynh takes out a map, and she shows it to Sarah. "Look, the farm is here. I think we'll get there before twelve."
"Perfect. Let's go!"

grammarNote.title: Will (quyết định, dự đoán)
grammarNote.bodyVi: Dùng will + động từ nguyên mẫu khi quyết định ngay lúc nói: It's sunny. I know! We'll rent bicycles, I'll ask the waiter, We'll take two. Dùng will để đoán: it won't be easy, I think we'll get there before twelve, I'll probably walk (probably đứng sau will, trước động từ). Hỏi ý kiến, rủ rê dùng shall we …?
examples: We'll rent bicycles and ride around the lake."
"Then I'll probably walk with my bicycle!"

Mình nghĩ trước mười hai giờ là tới."

grammarStep.questionVi: Trong câu "I'll probably walk", từ "probably" đứng ở đâu?
grammarStep.explanationVi: Probably đứng sau will và trước động từ: I'll probably walk. Với won't thì đứng trước: I probably won't walk.
grammarStep.whenVi: Dùng will khi quyết định ngay lúc nói và khi dự đoán; dùng shall we để rủ người khác cùng làm.

mistakes.wrong: I probably will walk with my bicycle.
mistakes.right: I'll probably walk with my bicycle.

grammarStep.noteVi: I'll = I will, we'll = we will, won't = will not. Khi nói, người bản xứ gần như luôn dùng dạng rút gọn.

exercises.promptVi: Sắp xếp các từ thành câu đúng.
exercises.explanationVi: I + will + probably + walk; từ "to" bị thừa.

writingHelp.grammarLabelVi: Có ít nhất 1 câu dùng will / won't
outlineVi: Bạn đang đi nghỉ ở đâu, thời tiết thế nào.
Bạn quyết định làm gì (I'll / We'll …).
Bạn đoán ngày hôm đó sẽ thế nào (I think … will …, probably).
writingHelp.modelAnswer: I'm on holiday in Hoi An with my friend. It's sunny today, so we'll rent bicycles and ride to the beach. I think it will be hot, so I'll take a big hat. We'll probably have lunch at a small restaurant near the sea. In the evening, we'll walk in the old town. It won't be a quiet day, but it will be fun!
